items.html: And afterward, when ZA is born, called by the name HaVaYaH as is known, then it is said, “Thus shall you say to the children of Israel, the Lord, God of your fathers,” etc., for ZA has already been born, and the name, the name of HaVaYaH, has been revealed. And let us return to the matter, that the wisdom of AA brought down the male drop, which is YAHU of the Hey's, which is MB in its throat, which is Bina, and there it was included within two drops, two Ehiyeh, which are Mayin Nukvin, and it is found that what is now revealed are the two Ehiyeh in the throat, which are twice MB as mentioned.
